City Museum Marks International Day of Learning
To mark the International Day of Learning, City Museum (CM) is emphasizing the important role of adult!education worldwide.In an email to members, CM noted that this year's celebration focuses on adult education programmes.
The museum exhibition, organized by CM in partnership with Prepare the Path foundation, features inspiring video testimonies, including one by a teacher in Bangladesh and another by a young man in Ghana.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the article?

options.B: To publicize a new educational partnership
options.C: To encourage adults to go back to school
options.D: To describe an exhibit at a local museum
